KPlugin.Name: Growth Layer Agent Helper
KPlugin.Description: Reports which application's window is focused (app id and owning PID) over D-Bus to the Growth Layer desktop agent, so it can attribute activity to an app on KDE Plasma Wayland. Never reports window titles, keystrokes, or pointer coordinates — only which app is focused, mirroring the same narrow contract the agent already uses on X11/Hyprland/GNOME/Windows/macOS.
